title: Fitzpatrick Park closed until further notice after train derailment - NewsBreak
text:
By Ashley Davidson ,
3 hours ago
BECKLEY, WV (WVNS) — Fitzpatrick Park in Beckley is closed until further notice due to a train derailment that happened May 24, 2026.
Culvert drainage replacements to cause potential traffic delays in part of Monroe County A statement from CSX said three out of twelve train cars carrying coal tipped onto their sides in the park during the derailment.
Molly Williams, Executive Director of Raleigh County Parks and Recreation Authority, said they are asking for the public’s patience as the situation is handled.
“Some coal was spilled within the park, and several other cars had derailed. CSX is currently working on cleaning that up and addressing some damage to one of their bridge trestles. They’re, you know, doing the best they can and working as fast as they can to get things cleaned up and back to normal, but it is gonna be a little bit,” said Williams.
The CSX statement said the bridge repair was completed Tuesday night; however, workers are still on hand to monitor the test train going over it sometime today to make sure it’s safe to use.
Williams said the clean-up could be completed as early as the end of this week, however, there is not an official date as to when the park will reopen.
